description: This Java source file defines the class ThingQueryCommandAdapter, which adapts ThingQueryCommand objects for the Eclipse Ditto protocol, mapping signals to adaptables and handling topic type determination

classes.name: ThingQueryCommandAdapter
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractThingAdapter and implements QueryCommandAdapter to handle mapping of ThingQueryCommand objects to adaptables, specifically for executing queries on 'things' in the Ditto protocol.

methods.name: ThingQueryCommandAdapter
methods.description: Private constructor initializing the adapter with specific mapping strategies and header translator.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Public static factory method to create a new instance of ThingQueryCommandAdapter with a given HeaderTranslator.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Overrides getType to determine the type string based on whether the topic path is a wildcard or not.

methods.name: mapSignalToAdaptable
methods.description: Maps a given ThingQueryCommand to an Adaptable object, using different signal mappers depending on the command type.
